summary: DDC Enterprise Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, announcing FY2025 earnings, a Bitcoin treasury platform launch, and share issuances to Satoshi Strategic Investments (conversion of preferred shares at $3.30/share) and Bristol Point Investment ($2.49/share). The Satoshi conversion yielded 9,924,598 Class A shares, subject to a one-year lock-up. Bristol Point issued 5,627,871 Class A shares. These are routine capital-raise updates, not a special-situation event. No merger, tender, or strategic review is involved. The filing reports financial results and ongoing BTC holdings (~2,383 BTC). No deal mechanics or risk-arb angle apply.
